arxiv-2212-10639.title: Hydrodynamic turbulence in disks with embedded planets
arxiv-2212-10639.creator: Alexandros Ziampras, Wilhelm Kley, Richard P. Nelson
arxiv-2212-10639.description: Abstract The vertical shear instability (VSI) is a source of hydrodynamic turbulence that can drive vigorous vertical mixing and moderate levels of accretion in protoplanetary disks, and it could be observable in the near future. With high-resolution three-dimensional numerical hydrodynamics simulations, we modeled the behavior of the VSI in protoplanetary disks with and without embedded planets.

arxiv-2310-07052.title: Uses of Sub-sample Estimates to Reduce Errors in Stochastic Optimization Models
arxiv-2310-07052.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . Optimization software enables the solution of problems with millions of variables and associated parameters. These parameters are, however, often uncertain and represented with an analytical description of the parameter’s distribution or with some form of sample. With large numbers of such parameters, optimization of the resulting model is often driven by mis-specifications or extreme sample characteristics, resulting in solutions that are far from a true optimum.

arxiv-2402-06839.title: Quantum interfaces with multilayered superwavelength atomic arrays
arxiv-2402-06839.creator: Roni Ben-Maimon, Yakov Solomons, Nir Davidson, Ofer Firstenberg, Ephraim Shahmoon
arxiv-2402-06839.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Roni Ben-Maimon, Yakov Solomons, Nir Davidson, Ofer Firstenberg, Ephraim Shahmoon. We consider quantum light-matter interfaces comprised of multiple layers of two-dimensional atomic arrays, whose lattice spacings exceed the wavelength of light. While the coupling of light to a single layer of such a ‘superwavelength’ lattice is considerably reduced due to scattering losses to high diffraction orders, we show that the addition of layers can suppress these losses through destructive interference between the layers.

arxiv-2407-17645.title: Hopfield Networks for Asset Allocation
arxiv-2407-17645.creator: Carlo Nicolini, Monisha Gopalan, Jacopo Staiano, Bruno Lepri
arxiv-2407-17645.description: Abstract We present the first application of modern Hopfield networks to the problem of portfolio optimization. We performed an extensive study based on combinatorial purged cross-validation over several datasets and compared our results to both traditional and deep-learning-based methods for portfolio selection.

arxiv-2502-18082.title: A Novel Approach to Identifying Open Star Cluster Members in Gaia DR3: Integrating MST and GMM Techniques
arxiv-2502-18082.creator: Rafe Sharif, M. Khakian Ghomi, M. Taefi
arxiv-2502-18082.description: Abstract We present a novel approach for identifying members of open star clusters using Gaia DR3 data by combining Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) and Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) techniques. Our method employs a three-step process: initial filtering based on astrometric parameters, MST analysis for spatial distribution filtering, and GMM for final membership probability determination.

arxiv-2509-20796.title: Fast Revocable Attribute-Based Encryption with Data Integrity for Internet of Things
arxiv-2509-20796.creator: Yongjiao Li, Liang Zhu, Yalin Deng, Qikun Zhang, Zhenlei Wang, Zhu Cao
arxiv-2509-20796.description: Abstract Efficient and secure revocable attribute-based encryption (RABE) is vital for ensuring flexible and fine-grained access control and data sharing in cloud storage and outsourced data environments within the Internet of Things (IoT). However, current RABE schemes often struggle to achieve an optimal balance between efficiency, security, dynamic scalability, and other important features, which hampers their practical application.

pmc-10696221.title: Computational exploration of the significance of COPS6 in cancer: Functional and clinical relevance across tumor types
pmc-10696221.creator: Shi-Lin Wang, Guang-Zheng Zhuo, Li-Ping Wang, Xiang-Hu Jiang, Guo-Hong Liu, Yun-Bao Pan, Yi-Rong Li
pmc-10696221.description: BACKGROUNDThe COP9 signalosome subunit 6 (COPS6) has been implicated in cancer progression, while its precise role in most types of cancer remains elusive.AIMTo investigate the functional and clinical relevance of COPS6 across various tumor types using publicly available databases.METHODSWe used R software and online analysis databases to analyze the differential expression, prognosis, mutation and related functions of COPS6 in pan-cancer.

pmc-11492411.title: Vitamin D supplementation decrease asthma exacerbations in children: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-11492411.creator: Katherine Fedora, Retno Asih Setyoningrum, Qorri’ Aina, Laili Nur Rosyidah, Nur Lailatun Ni’mah, Feelin Fatwa Titiharja
pmc-11492411.description: BackgroundObservational studies have linked low vitamin D (VD) levels to increased asthma attacks in children. Subsequent meta-analyses of adults and children revealed that VD treatment might benefit asthmatic patients by reducing the incidence of exacerbations. Therefore, this review aims to analyze the effects of VD supplementation in reducing asthma exacerbations in children.

pmc-12227850.title: Male minority youth and law enforcement officers' policing perceptions and reported experiences and practices: Qualitative exploration of reciprocal socialization beliefs regarding respect
pmc-12227850.creator: Margaret Beale Spencer
pmc-12227850.description: A specific theory‐guided, humanity‐focused perspective addresses the “how” and “why” of America's long‐standing racial tension and the patterned problem of wrongful Black deaths. Qualitative data coding and analysis indicate interpersonal and relational misalignments between male youth of color (MYC) and law enforcement officers (LEO).

pmc-12539728.title: Caregivers’ practices and factors associated with malaria vaccine uptake among under-five children in the Tiko Health District, Cameroon: A community based cross-sectional study
pmc-12539728.creator: Idang Maureen Abiache, Divine Nsobinenyui, Chrisantus Eweh Ukah, Yunika Larissa Kumenyuy, Ngu Claudia Ngeha, Randolf Wefuan, Syveline Zuh Dang, Ndip Esther Ndip, Mirabelle Pandong Feguem, Dickson S. Nsagha, Abhinav Sinha, David Musoke, David Musoke, David Musoke
pmc-12539728.description: Malaria remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality among children under five in Cameroon. In 2021, the World Health Organization (WHO) recommended the RTS,S/AS01 malaria vaccine for children in areas with moderate to high transmission. This study assessed caregivers’ practices and factors associated with malaria vaccine uptake among under-five children in the Tiko Health District.

pmc-12567598.title: Behavioral Predictors of Intentional and Unintentional Nonadherence to Antiretroviral Therapy and Their Implications for Virological Failure Among People with HIV in Taiwan
pmc-12567598.creator: Su-Han Hsu, Chien-Chun Wang, Yung-Feng Yen, Tsen-Fang Yen, Po-Tsen Yeh, Hsin-Hao Lai, Alberto Borghetti
pmc-12567598.description: Adherence to antiretroviral therapy (ART) is critical for HIV management and sustained virological suppression. Differentiating intentional from unintentional nonadherence is essential for developing tailored interventions, yet evidence from Asian populations remains limited. A cross-sectional study of 846 people with HIV (PWH) in northern Taiwan assessed ART adherence using the MARS-5 scale.

pmc-12692418.title: Heterogeneity of Orodental Features in a Family with Noonan Syndrome
pmc-12692418.creator: Gréta Antal, Laura Csabai, Anna Zsigmond, Ildiko Szanto, Kinga Hadzsiev, Judit Bene
pmc-12692418.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Noonan syndrome is a relatively common genetic syndrome with clinical and genetic heterogeneity. Besides the characteristic features such as short stature, typical facial features, congenital heart defects, skeletal and ocular anomalies, various orodental manifestations occur with variable frequency. High-arched palate, malocclusions, micrognathism, giant cell lesions, and anomalous lateral incisors are frequently observed features, whereas supernumerary teeth, hypodontia, macrodontia, enamel hypoplasia, severe dental caries, impacted teeth, delayed eruption, taurodontism and odontoma have occasionally been reported.

pmc-12756729.title: Understanding the Fidelity and Specificity of DNA Polymerase I
pmc-12756729.creator: Bill R. Miller, Andrew V. Yeager, Jake A. Collins, Angus Beane, Alexis Blake, Elise Tate, Carol A. Parish, Eugene Y. Wu
pmc-12756729.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). High-fidelity DNA polymerases employ complex mechanisms to catalyze template-dependent DNA synthesis while quickly discarding mismatches. Atomic-level structural details about short-lived states during nucleotide discrimination are necessary to gain insight into the kinetic checkpoints that contribute to fidelity. We performed microsecond molecular dynamics simulations of DNA polymerase I, large fragment, from Bacillus stearothermophilus (Bacillus fragment, or BF) in complex with a template guanine and a mismatched thymidine triphosphate to observe the early events in the process of selection against a mismatch.

pmc-13096923.title: Bone turnover in postmenopausal women during denosumab treatment: Biomarker analysis in naive and discontinuing patients
pmc-13096923.creator: Mikolaj Bartosik, Esther Wolf, Alexander Simon, Felix N von Brackel, Oskar Windels, Ulrich C Klostermeier, Florian Barvencik, Michael Amling, Ralf Oheim
pmc-13096923.description: ObjectivesOsteoporosis is characterized by an imbalance in bone turnover, with increased resorption over formation. Antiresorptive treatment, such as denosumab (Dmab), aims to restore this balance, making monitoring of bone turnover markers useful. Key bone resorption parameters are serum C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen (CTX) and urinary deoxypyridinoline/creatinine (DPD).

pmc-13207822.title: Comparative Prognostic Accuracy of Objective Nutritional Indices in Critically Ill Patients with Sepsis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13207822.creator: Yan-Wu Yang, Yan Zhang, Tian-Yi Qu, Mei-Ling Ge, Zhi Wan
pmc-13207822.description: Background: Nutritional indices are increasingly studied as prognostic tools in sepsis, but their comparative value remains uncertain. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate associations between major nutritional indices and mortality in adult sepsis. Methods: PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science were searched for eligible studies.

pmc-13492871.title: Effective policies on prevention and control of cardiovascular diseases in different countries: A realistic review
pmc-13492871.creator: Aliasghar Valipour, Ali Mohammad Mosadegh Rad, Mohammad Mahboubi, Mohammad Arab
pmc-13492871.description: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are responsible for 60% of deaths from noncommunicable diseases worldwide. Iran’s CVD control and prevention program faces challenges that have limited its effectiveness and efficiency. This study aimed to identify effective programs, policies, and interventions for the prevention and control of CVDs in Iran. The realistic review method was used to conduct this research.
